svg.title: Option A: Single Topic (status quo)
svg.desc: RFD 0007 — Topic Strategy Option A. Multiple Airflow deployments (each with an embedded astro-dependency-plugin) both produce to and consume from a single Kafka topic. Plugin filters out events from its own deployment. Non-Airflow consumers also subscribe with client-side filters.
svg.text: Each Airflow deployment embeds astro-dependency-plugin and is BOTH a producer and consumer on one shared Kafka topic.

g.text: single topic carries every event type — consumers must filter by `type` in the payload
Single Kafka topic carrying all event types
